system.description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.
system.notes:
Champion | Ranged

A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.
Motives & Tactics: Take what belongs to others, hold grudges

Difficulty: 15 | Thresholds: 7/15 | HP: 6 | Stress: 6

ATK: +4 | Magic: Far | 2d8+3 direct

Experience: Manipulation +3

Features

Unhinged - Passive: Their standard attack deals direct damage.

My Turn - Reaction: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

Rivalry - Reaction: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

What’s Yours Is Mine - Reaction: When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item of their choice from the target’s inventory.
